reviewItem.question: If an exposed environment does nothing about "Implicit IPv4 preference when enabling JMX has been removed, and will now use JVM defaults", what happens, and is that review or action? proposed: behavior-change

consequence.statement: When JMX is enabled, the JVM default IP address preference now applies instead of the implicit IPv4 preference. IPv6-only clusters now boot correctly.

proposed.statement: The implicit IPv4 preference applied when JMX is enabled has been removed; the JVM defaults now apply.
